structure Allocator where
  create : ∀ {α : Type}, α → Except String (Box α)
  destroy : ∀ {α : Type}, Box α → Except String Unit
  dupe : ∀ {α : Type}, [Inhabited α] → Array α → Except String (Array α)
  free : ∀ {α : Type}, Array α → Except String Unit

def Box.get {α : Type} (box : Box α) : α := box.unsafeCast

def Box.set {α : Type} (box : Box α) (val : α) : Box α :=
  Box.mk val

class HasAllocator (α : Type) where
  allocator : Allocator

def mkAllocator : Allocator :=
  { create := fun α x => pure (Box.mk x)
  , destroy := fun α box => pure ()
  , dupe := fun α _ arr => pure arr
  , free := fun α arr => pure ()
  }

namespace MyComplex

def mul (a b : MyComplex) : MyComplex :=
  { re := a.re * b.re - a.im * b.im, im := a.re * b.im + a.im * b.re }

def conjugate (c : MyComplex) : MyComplex :=
  { re := c.re, im := -c.im }

def magnitude (c : MyComplex) : Float :=
  Float.sqrt (c.re * c.re + c.im * c.im)

def addNode (g : Graph) (n : Node) : Graph := { g with nodes := g.nodes ++ [n] }
def addEdge (g : Graph) (e : Edge) : Graph := { g with edges := g.edges ++ [e] }

def isConsistent (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ g.edges, (∃ n ∈ g.nodes, n.id = e.src) ∧ (∃ n ∈ g.nodes, n.id = e.dst)

theorem empty_graph_consistent : ({ nodes := [], edges := [] } : Graph).isConsistent := by
  simp [Graph.isConsistent]

theorem addNode_preserves_consistency (g : Graph) (n : Node) : g.isConsistent → (g.addNode n).isConsistent := by
  intro h; simp [Graph.isConsistent, Graph.addNode] at *
  intro e he; obtain ⟨hsrc, hdst⟩ := h e he
  exact ⟨⟨_, Or.inl hsrc.1, hsrc.2⟩, ⟨_, Or.inl hdst.1, hdst.2⟩⟩

theorem addNode_increases_count (g : Graph) (n : Node) : (g.addNode n).nodeCount = g.nodeCount + 1 := by
  simp [Graph.addNode, Graph.nodeCount, List.length_append]

  simp [Graph.addEdge, Graph.edgeCount, List.length_append]

theorem addEdge_preserves_nodes (g : Graph) (e : Edge) : (g.addEdge e).nodes = g.nodes := rfl

  | none => none

def getFractalDimension (v : ZVariable) : Float :=
  let n := v.graph.nodeCount
  let e := v.graph.edgeCount
  if n < 2 || e == 0 then 0.0
  else Float.log (Float.ofNat e) / Float.log (Float.ofNat n)

def assign (v : ZVariable) (value : String) (timestamp : Int) : ZVariable :=
  let newNode : Node :=
    { id := s!"node_{v.graph.nodes.length}", content := value,
      qubit := { a := MyComplex.mk 1.0 0.0, b := MyComplex.mk 0.0 0.0, allocator := v.allocator },
      allocator := v.allocator }
  let newHistory : HistoryEntry := { entry_type := .assign, value := value, timestamp := timestamp }
  { v with
    graph := v.graph.addNode newNode,
    history := v.history ++ [newHistory],
    quantum_states := v.quantum_states ++ [{ alpha_re := 1.0, alpha_im := 0.0, beta_re := 0.0, beta_im := 0.0, allocator := v.allocator }],
    last_node_id := some newNode.id }

def invariant (r : ZRuntime) : Prop :=
  (∀ (n1 n2 : String × ZVariable), n1 ∈ r.variables → n2 ∈ r.variables → n1.1 = n2.1 → n1 = n2)

theorem empty_runtime_invariant : ZRuntime.empty.invariant := by
  simp [ZRuntime.invariant, ZRuntime.empty]

theorem createVariable_preserves_invariant (r : ZRuntime) (name : String) (val : Option String) (t : Int) :
    r.invariant → r.hasVariable name = false → ∀ r', r.createVariable name val t = some r' → r'.invariant := by
  intro hinv hnovar r' hcreate
  simp [ZRuntime.createVariable, hnovar] at hcreate
  subst hcreate
  simp [ZRuntime.invariant] at *
  intro n1 n2 hn1 hn2 heq
  cases hn1 <;> cases hn2 <;> simp_all

def historyMonotonic (r1 r2 : ZRuntime) : Prop :=
  r1.execution_history.length ≤ r2.execution_history.length

theorem createVariable_history_monotonic (r : ZRuntime) (name : String) (val : Option String) (t : Int) :
    r.hasVariable name = false → ∀ r', r.createVariable name val t = some r' → r.historyMonotonic r' := by
  intro h r' hcr
  simp [ZRuntime.createVariable, h] at hcr
  subst hcr
  simp [ZRuntime.historyMonotonic, List.length_append]
  omega

def SystemInvariant (r : ZRuntime) : Prop :=
  r.invariant ∧ r.global_graph.isConsistent ∧ (∀ p ∈ r.variables, p.2.graph.isConsistent)

theorem empty_system_invariant : SystemInvariant ZRuntime.empty :=
  ⟨empty_runtime_invariant, empty_graph_consistent, by simp [ZRuntime.empty]⟩

def ZRuntime.createVariable (r : ZRuntime) (name : String) (initial_value : Option String) (timestamp : Int) : Option ZRuntime :=
  if r.hasVariable name then none else
    let newVar : ZVariable :=
      match initial_value with
      | some val => (ZVariable.empty name).assign val timestamp
      | none => ZVariable.empty name
    let newHistory : ExecutionHistoryEntry :=
      { action := .create_variable, primary_target := name, secondary_targets := [],
        operation_type := none, result_value := initial_value, result_int := none,
        result_float := none, timestamp := timestamp, allocator := r.allocator }
    some { r with
      variables := r.variables ++ [(name, newVar)],
      execution_history := r.execution_history ++ [newHistory] }

    r.hasVariable name = true → r.createVariable name val t = none := by
  intro h; simp [ZRuntime.createVariable, h]

    r.hasVariable name = false → (r.createVariable name val t).isSome := by
  intro h; simp [ZRuntime.createVariable, h]

  intro h; simp [ZRuntime.createVariable, h, ZRuntime.variableCount, List.length_append]; exact ⟨_, rfl, rfl⟩

def ZRuntime.deleteVariable (r : ZRuntime) (name : String) (timestamp : Int) : ZRuntime × Bool :=
  if r.hasVariable name then
    let newHistory : ExecutionHistoryEntry :=
      { action := .delete_variable, primary_target := name, secondary_targets := [],
        operation_type := none, result_value := none, result_int := none,
        result_float := none, timestamp := timestamp, allocator := r.allocator }
    ({ r with
      variables := r.variables.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ name),
      execution_history := r.execution_history ++ [newHistory] }, true)
  else (r, false)

def ZVariable.relateTo (self : Box ZVariable) (other : Box ZVariable) (relationship_type : EdgeQuality) :
    Except String Unit :=
  do
    let self_val := self.get
    let other_val := other.get
    when self_val.graph.get.nodeCount = 0 || other_val.graph.get.nodeCount = 0 do
      pure ()
    let self_node_id ← getLatestNodeId self
    let other_node_id ← getLatestNodeId other
    let self_qubit ←
      match self_val.graph.get.getQuantumState self_node_id with
      | some q => pure q
      | none => pure (Qubit.initBasis0.a)
    let other_qubit ←
      match other_val.graph.get.getQuantumState other_node_id with
      | some q => pure q
      | none => pure (Qubit.initBasis0.a)
    let other_conj := other_qubit.conjugate
    let correlation := self_qubit.mul other_conj
    let weight := correlation.magnitude
    let fractal_dim : Float := 0.0
    when self_val.graph.get.getNodeConst other_node_id = none do
      match other_val.graph.get.getNodeConst other_node_id with
      | some other_node =>
        let cloned ← other_node.clone self_val.allocator
        let _ ← self_val.graph.get.addNode cloned
      | none => pure ()
    let edge := edgeInitCompat self_val.allocator self_node_id other_node_id relationship_type weight correlation fractal_dim
    let _ ← self_val.graph.get.addEdge self_node_id other_node_id edge
    let buf : Array UInt8 := #[]
    let relate_str := "relate"
    let history_entry ← HistoryEntry.init self_val.allocator HistoryEntryType.relate relate_str
    let _ ← self_val.history.append history_entry
    pure ()

  do
    let self_val := self.get
    when self_val.logic.get.stateCount > 0 do
      let indices := #[self_val.logic.get.stateCount - 1]
      let _ ← self_val.logic.get.applyGate gate indices params
    let history_entry ← HistoryEntry.init self_val.allocator HistoryEntryType.transform (gate.toString)
    let _ ← self_val.history.append history_entry
    pure ()

def ZVariable.measure (self : Box ZVariable) : MeasurementResult :=
  let self_val := self.get
  if self_val.logic.get.stateCount > 0 then
    let result := self_val.logic.get.measure (self_val.logic.get.stateCount - 1)
    let buf : Array UInt8 := #[]
    let measure_str := "measure"
    let _ ←
      match HistoryEntry.init self_val.allocator HistoryEntryType.measure measure_str with
      | Ok history_entry =>
        match self_val.history.append history_entry with
        | Ok _ => pure ()
        | Error _ =>
          history_entry.deinit
          pure ()
      | Error _ => pure ()
    result
  else
    { result := 0, probability := 0.0, collapsed_state := QuantumState.init 1.0 0.0 0.0 0.0 }
